title: Armstrong Number
description: Checks a three-digit number for the Armstrong property.

data.question: Write a program that reads a three-digit number and prints True when the sum of its digits each raised to the third power equals the number, otherwise False.

brief.summary: Checks a three-digit number for the Armstrong property.

sections.heading: Question
sections.body: Write a program that reads a three-digit number and prints True when the sum of its digits each raised to the third power equals the number, otherwise False.

sections.heading: What the supplied code does
sections.body: It sums N[0], N[1] and N[2] raised to the power len(N), so the input must have exactly three characters for the intended result.
